title: US Credit-Fear Hits 8-Month High as Tech Angst Roils Markets (2)
html:
Measures of perceived US credit risk reached levels not seen in nearly eight months and the cost of protecting the debt of some of the biggest tech firms against default jumped on Friday, as the wobbling AI trade spurred volatility in global markets and sent investors piling into safe havens.

The spread on S&P Dow Jones Indices’ CDX Investment-Grade Index, which rises as fears climb, jumped as much as 2.9 basis points to 65.5 basis points, the highest intraday level since the end of March. A similar gauge for high-yield bonds, which falls as credit risk increases, fell about ...
